method: compared the frozen module against an independently written reference implementation (explicit loops, no shared code) on synthetic scores with an unbalanced cohort of 60 parents holding 1 to 8 normal segments each

checks.invariant_to_monotone_within_arm_transfo: verified under x*1000, +7 and exp; max |dC| = 0
checks.no_segment_level_pseudo_replication: the bootstrap resamples parents; segments move with their parent and are never drawn individually

bootstrap.frozen_procedure: fold-stratified: 12 parents resampled with replacement within each of the five folds, 10000 replicates, seed 27182, percentile 95
bootstrap.reference_agreement: module and independent reference intervals agree to three decimal places; exact equality is not expected because the two implementations consume the random stream in a different order
